answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in basalt, not in usernames anyone can copy. Under a stone-ledger apprenticeship, a newcomer locks 200 tokens for 90 days and completes 20 public tasks, each checked by three unrelated peers, before earning full trading rights; fraud slashes bond and reputation. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 200,000 locked tokens and 20,000 peer-reviewed tasks, and one exposed fraud sends a ripple of slashing through every linked identity. Honest work is the signal no farm can fake at scale, like a lighthouse beam: cheap to see, costly to counterfeit.
